name: YNX DEX
summary: Non-custodial YNX Testnet DEX candidate with public indexed market data, deterministic local routing and exact Wallet-reviewed actions.
userBoundary: Public market data can be tried without login. Account positions need a live central Wallet session. No transaction can execute without a separate exact Wallet review.
disclosure: The public chain-native Testnet market has one labelled test-liquidity pool and verified indexed lifecycle evidence. It is not production liquidity. EVM contracts, production audit, APY/TVL claims, production signing and store release remain absent.
